test_register_matplotlib_converters: test the register_matplotlib_converters function that registers pandas datetime converters with matplotlib
test_deregister_matplotlib_converters: test the deregister_matplotlib_converters function that removes pandas datetime converters from matplotlib registry
test_datetime_converter: test the DatetimeConverter class that converts datetime objects and strings to matplotlib numeric format
test_period_converter: test the PeriodConverter class that converts Period objects to matplotlib ordinal numeric format
test_timedelta_formatter: test the TimeSeries_TimedeltaFormatter class that formats timedelta ticks for matplotlib plots
test_quarterly_finder: test the _quarterly_finder function that computes quarterly axis tick positions for matplotlib date plots
